impulse.def: The product of the average force and the time it acts, J = F_avg Δt: a vector in N·s, equal to the area under a force-time graph.

impulse-momentum-theorem.def: The net impulse on an object equals its change in momentum: J = Δp.

force-time-graph.def: A graph of force against time; the area under it is the impulse.

momentum-time-graph.def: A graph of momentum against time; its slope is the net force on the object.
